text_block_list.text: One day, with the Arima Kinen drawing near—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I planned a Christmas party.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In Japan, "Christmas" is a night
spent with family, friends, or a romantic partner.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Normally, this is a day that should be spent with Master,
but unfortunately, the Arima Kinen is right around the corner on that day."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
And so, to make up for that, I've devised and planned
a party where you can feel the Christmas spirit even more,
based on reference materials and survey results.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Preparations are complete, and we are ready to begin at any time.
Shall we proceed with the Christmas party?
And so, Mihono Bourbon's Christmas party began.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, first off, as an icebreaker—
I shall sing a Christmas song.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I practiced in my room last night.
Please listen. —"Jingle Bells."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —Jingle bells, jingle bells.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ♪ To the rhythm of bells, rings of light dance around ♪
Mihono Bourbon's monotonic singing voice echoed for quite a while...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Were you able to break the ice, Master?

"To tell the truth, an icebreaker at this point
is hardly necessary, but seeing those expectant eyes—"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Mission complete. Proceeding next
to socialization and meal time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To guarantee Master's satisfaction,
I conducted a school-wide survey beforehand—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have prepared the top 10
classic "quintessential" Christmas menu items.

—And Mihono Bourbon brought out dish after dish.
In no time at all, the table was brightly and lavishly adorned.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I've prepared roast chicken, roast beef, cream stew, meat pies, lasagna—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: A wreath salad, canapés, cream pasta, and a Bûche de Noël for dessert.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I've also prepared a delivery menu just in case an unforeseen situation arises.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Now then, please, "Bon appétit."
The amount is... well, quite large, but since Mihono Bourbon went through the trouble of preparing it, I want to finish every last bite.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —All dishes confirmed cleared. 'Thank you for the meal.'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Master, you have not moved an inch for some time. Is something wrong...?

My stomach is so bloated that I don't think I can move for a while,
but the food was absolutely delicious.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Mission complete.
Proceeding to gift presentation phase.

—And Mihono Bourbon brought out
a box that looked like a present.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Since I did not know what Master currently desired, I prepared something with high practical utility.

Opening the present—inside
was a set of laundry detergent!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"I was inspired by 'housewarming gifts.'
I debated whether to go with soba noodles, but—what do you think?"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Mission complete.
Present delivery, successful.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
By the way, this is the same detergent I use,
so I can vouch for its cleaning power.
For a while after that, the laundry carried the scent of Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: If it is to Master's liking, I am "happy."

Opening the present—inside
was a hand-knitted scarf!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This is a scarf made from Merino wool
ordered all the way from New Zealand.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It has excellent heat retention, feels pleasant against the skin,
and is even equipped with odor-resistant properties.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
As the harsh cold days are set to continue,
I made this thinking it might help keep you warm.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Mission complete.
Present delivery was successful.
The finished scarf didn't have a single loose thread, looking just like something you'd buy in a store.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I'm good at monotonous, repetitive tasks.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Because the movements were so uniform,
Nishino Flower was recording a video.
Swallowing the urge to say I'd really love to see that video, I wrapped the muffler around my neck.
